findings.location: stanza lines 15-16 (English: "For the eyes of the Lord seek to and fro, To find one perfect, His power He’ll show!")
findings.source_quote:
For the eyes of the Lord seek to and fro,
To find one perfect, His power He’ll show!
findings.suggested_fix: Preserve the possessive reference to God. Replace "وستظهر قوتها!" with a phrasing that clearly attributes the action and power to the Lord, for example: "لأن عيون الرب تفتش هنا وهناك،\nلتجد واحدًا كاملًا، فسيُظهر قوّته!" (keep the same HTML structure and line break tags).
findings.translation_quote:
لأن عيون الرب تفتش هنا وهناك،
لتجد واحدًا كاملًا، وستظهر قوتها!

findings.location: line 11 (English: "When faced with God’s power, that devil—he hides!")
findings.source_quote: When faced with God’s power, that devil—he hides!
findings.suggested_fix: Clarify the subject to match the English meaning (that the devil hides when confronted with God’s power). Suggested wording: "عندما يواجه الشيطان قوة الله — يختبئ!" or, preserving the original rhythm, "عندما يُواجَه بقدرة الله، ذلك الشيطان — يختبئ!" (preserve the same HTML tags).
findings.translation_quote: عندما يواجه قوة الله، ذلك الشيطان—يختبئ!
